image_alt: A whippet and a black and white dog stand side by side on a narrow sandy path through long grass.

text.facebook: Suspected parvovirus cases in Shropshire have one rescue centre turning away unvaccinated dogs, the BBC reported. PDSA says parvo can survive for months to years in parks and fields, and vaccination is the only real protection. My tip: find your dog's vaccination card today and check when the next booster is due. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/parvovirus-and-boosters
